name: Next Profile
description: Next Collection profile family: one person (employee, customer contact, speaker) in 10 current-generation styles across four directions. Motion: an orbiting light ring around the avatar and a card frame with travelling beams. Depth: a tilting holographic staff ID, a flip card with contact details on the back, and a swaying lanyard badge. Bold: neo-brutalism, claymorphism and a die-cut sticker. Smart: a bento profile that recomposes its tiles by width and a compact row that expands into a full bio. It keeps the anatomy of the Universal Theme profile patterns (avatar, name, role, presence, figures, action) and every color comes from the active theme style. Beam and ring techniques adapted from Magic UI (border-beam, orbiting-circles), MIT.
helpText: Pick a Style, then map Name (required) and any of Role, Image URL or Initials, Bio, Status, up to three stats, Link URL and Link Label, Email, Phone, Location, Organisation and Reference. Empty settings are left out. Tilt Holo ID needs the plug-in JavaScript file for its pointer tilt and works without it as a static card. Every hover effect also runs on keyboard focus, and all motion stops when the user asks the system for reduced motion.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: Profile design, grouped by direction. MOTION - Orbit Ring: a rotating light ring around the avatar with the status dot in orbit. Beam Frame: two beams of light travel around the card frame. DEPTH - Tilt Holo ID: a staff ID card that tilts toward the pointer under a holographic sheen, with Organisation and Reference. Flip Contact: identity on the front, Email, Phone and Location on the back, turned on hover, focus or tap. Lanyard Badge: a conference badge hanging from a strap that sways gently. BOLD - Neo Brutal: ink borders, hard shadows and flat fills. Clay: pillowy soft-shadow surfaces. Sticker: a die-cut sticker with a peeling corner. SMART - Bento Profile: stats, bio and contact as bento tiles that recompose by region width. Expand Bio: a compact row that morphs open to show Bio, stats and contact on hover, focus or tap.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.helpText: Full name of the person, for example Sara Al-Harbi. Rendered as the h3 heading.

attributes.name: Role
attributes.helpText: Optional job title or team, for example Senior Account Manager.

attributes.name: Image URL
attributes.helpText: Optional avatar image URL. Must be developer-controlled, for example a column built with apex_util.get_blob_file_src or an #APP_FILES# path, never free user input. The image is decorative; the name carries the meaning.

attributes.name: Initials
attributes.helpText: One or two letters shown when there is no image, for example SH. Build them in SQL from the name.

attributes.name: Bio
attributes.helpText: Optional short description of one or two sentences. Tilt Holo ID and Lanyard Badge leave it out.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.helpText: Optional presence: online, away, busy or offline, shown as a colored dot plus text. Any other value is shown as plain text in a neutral color, for example On leave.

attributes.name: Stat 1 Value
attributes.helpText: First key figure, for example 128 or SAR 2.4M. Format it in SQL. Shown by Orbit Ring, Beam Frame, Neo Brutal, Clay, Sticker, Bento Profile and Expand Bio.

attributes.name: Stat 1 Label
attributes.helpText: Caption for Stat 1, for example Deals won.

attributes.name: Stat 2 Value
attributes.helpText: Second key figure, for example 128 or SAR 2.4M. Format it in SQL. Shown by Orbit Ring, Beam Frame, Neo Brutal, Clay, Sticker, Bento Profile and Expand Bio.

attributes.name: Stat 2 Label
attributes.helpText: Caption for Stat 2, for example Deals won.

attributes.name: Stat 3 Value
attributes.helpText: Third key figure, for example 128 or SAR 2.4M. Format it in SQL. Shown by Orbit Ring, Beam Frame, Neo Brutal, Clay, Sticker, Bento Profile and Expand Bio.

attributes.name: Stat 3 Label
attributes.helpText: Caption for Stat 3, for example Deals won.

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target of the profile, for example an apex_page.get_url link to the employee page. The name becomes a link that covers the card; Flip Contact and Expand Bio show it as a button. The value must be developer-controlled.

attributes.name: Link Label
attributes.helpText: Visible text of the link, for example View profile. Defaults to View profile.

attributes.name: Email
attributes.helpText: Optional email address shown as a mailto link by Flip Contact on the back, Bento Profile and Expand Bio, for example sara.alharbi@example.com.

attributes.name: Phone
attributes.helpText: Optional phone number shown as text next to Email, for example +966 11 555 0142.

attributes.name: Location
attributes.helpText: Optional office or city, for example Riyadh HQ, Floor 12. Shown with the contact details.

attributes.name: Organisation
attributes.helpText: Optional company, department or event name, for example Oracle APEX World 2026. Tilt Holo ID and Lanyard Badge print it in the header band; other styles show it under the role.

attributes.name: Reference
attributes.helpText: Optional badge or employee number, for example EMP-00412. Tilt Holo ID and Lanyard Badge print it with a barcode strip.

attributes.name: Columns
attributes.helpText: Report mode only. Empty fits as many profiles as the region width allows. The fixed options are a maximum: columns drop automatically when a profile would get too narrow.
